profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an online learning platform operated as a business of Learneo, Inc. The company's site describes it as providing instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, tutors, and related academic support, with the stated aim of helping students get unstuck.

The held facts associate Course Hero with QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool categorized under writing and editing, which is listed as a product connected to the Course Hero website. No financial figures, litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
